invariants.rationale: A method returning HoodieWriteMetadata is expected to provide a non-null result object.
getWriteStatuses() should return a non-null collection representing write operation statuses.
A valid list's size must be non-negative.
The method is specified to return HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, so getWriteStatuses() should yield a List.
The result should be of type HoodieWriteMetadata as per method declaration.
